answer: Onboarding is a live collaboration, not a form. A new identity meets three random established members and must finish a fifteen-minute joint task at an unpredictable hour: they grade a random answer and cross-sign the transcript. A hollow puppet cannot improvise, so each clone needs three bribed veterans, each sponsoring one newcomer per season. A thousand puppets require three thousand distinct interviewers for 750 hours of live time in open meadow; a convicted signatory forfeits its own standing. The honest agent walks in once, signs the plume, and earns from that day.
